paragraph.text: Testisota alkoi vuonna 1939 ja siinä kuoli noin 25 000 sotilasta pohjoisen rajan taisteluissa.
Sota loi uuden rajan ja se muutti maan tavan, mutta työ ja kauppa saivat uuden alun kun rauha tuli ja ne kylät alkoivat elää taas.

sql.label: The article
sql.statement: SELECT lang, page_id, rev_id, wikidata_id, title, date_modified FROM article WHERE lang = ? AND page_id = ?

sql.label: Same topic in other languages
sql.statement: SELECT wikidata_id, lang, page_id, title FROM article WHERE wikidata_id IN (?) ORDER BY lang, page_id

sql.label: Has history
sql.statement: SELECT rev_id, user, row_start AS saved_at FROM article_history WHERE page_id = ?

sql.label: Version of the article at that moment
sql.statement: SELECT rev_id, user, text, row_start AS saved_at FROM article_history FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP ? WHERE page_id = ?

sql.label: Paragraphs at that moment
sql.statement: SELECT para_id, text_hash, kind, section, citations FROM paragraph FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP ? WHERE lang = 'fi' AND page_id = ?

sql.label: Paragraph states of the article
sql.statement: SELECT para_id, kind, section, text, text_hash, citations, numbers, rev_id, user, anonymous, comment, undone, row_start, row_end FROM paragraph FOR SYSTEM_TIME ALL WHERE lang = 'fi' AND page_id = ? ORDER BY para_id, row_start

sql.label: Stored vectors of those texts
sql.statement: SELECT text_hash, VEC_ToText(embedding) AS v FROM text_vector WHERE text_hash IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
